questions.question: The school is looking for new team coaches and managers because

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到去年帮忙的家长中，有一些人现在有了“其他安排（other commitments）”，这对应了选项B中的“放弃了这些角色（given up these roles）”。
你可能会因为听到录音列举了多个不同年级的运动队名称而自己脑补选项A或C，但录音并没有提到学校整体对运动的兴趣增加，也没有说引入了新运动项目。

First up, we're looking for parents who would like to become team coaches or managers. We had some excellent people last year, but some of those parents now have other commitments. It's the year four netball team, the year five and six rugby teams, and the year three hockey team that need new people.

questions.question: What does the speaker say is the most important thing a coach needs?

analyses.content: 录音中强调教练真正需要的是“正确的态度（the right attitude）”，即能够激励孩子并让比赛看起来令人兴奋，这对应了选项B的“让孩子们对运动产生热情的能⼒”。
你可能会听到“knowledge of the game”或“whole season”而误选A或C，但录音明确指出懂规则只是“有帮助（helps）”，并非最重要的要求。

Obviously, knowledge of the game helps, but if you're keen, there are some coaching courses you can take before the training sessions for players begin, and these also get held throughout the whole season. What's really required is the right attitude. Are you the kind of person that can motivate kids and make the game seem exciting?

questions.question: For parents who would like to coach rugby, one requirement is that they

analyses.content: 录音提到如果想当橄榄球教练，你需要去参加一个即将到来的“重要日子（important day）”，这一天孩子们会报名登记组队，完美对应选项A的“参加即将举行的注册登记活动”。
录音在后文确实提到了星期六早上有比赛以及星期三有训练，但并没有说强制要求教练每周必须参加两次活动，所以不要选B。

If you do volunteer to become a rugby coach, you'll need to go along to an important day that's coming up. That's on Saturday the twenty-third. It takes place on the rugby grounds, and it's when all the kids put their names down for a team, and the organizers are on hand to give parents a bit more information.

questions.question: In order to get a netball uniform, parents will need to

analyses.content: 录音明确指出，家长必须花15美元向学校秘书“租借（hire）”队服，这笔钱在赛季结束时会“退还（refunded）”，这个机制就等于选项A所说的“付押金（pay a deposit）”。
你可能会听到“sports store in town”就急着去选C，但这只是学校订购队服的地方，并非要求家长亲自去体育用品店购买。
And for uniforms, we've just ordered a new set from the sports store in town, and parents must hire one from the school secretary for fifteen dollars, which gets refunded at the end of the season.
录音提示先找到“北停车场（north car park）”，饮水站设在停车场马路对面，紧挨着“旗杆（flag post）”的地方，对应地图上的字母C。
你可能会在听到“north car park”时就立刻去找它旁边的字母A，但必须听完后面的定位条件，目标其实在马路对面且靠近旗杆。
The drink station is one. If you're handing out water, head to the north car park, and the station will be set up on the other side of the road from it, right by the flag post.
以学校为起点沿小路上行，在三岔路口走“左侧那条路（left-hand path）”向西，过河点就在你“穿过Summer Street之前（just before you cross Summer Street）”的位置，对应字母H。
你可能会在三岔路口跟错方向，或者没有注意到“穿过街道之前”这个限制条件而选成了其他字母。

Two or three parents will be needed to help out at the major crossing point just to make sure everybody's going the right way. So on the map, there's that little footpath going up past the school, then it splits into three directions. The crossing point is at the end of the left-hand path, heading west just before you cross Summer Street.
录音让你先找到地图最左侧的“四栋建筑（four buildings）”，半程点就在这四栋建筑的“正右侧（just to the right）”，对应字母B。
不要把这里的建筑和“南停车场（South car park）”混淆，务必找准“最左侧（far left-hand side）”的四栋小房子作为唯一的参照物。

Now, we'll need a couple of parents at the halfway point to send the children in the right direction. So there are four buildings on the far left-hand side. The halfway point is just to the right of these buildings.
从学校旁边的小路往上走，在“第二个右转路口（second turning on the right）”走下去，位置在卫星天线的“对面（opposite）”，对应字母F。
你很容易在这个行进路线中提前在“第一个右转路口”拐弯而迷失到字母I去了，一定要听准是第二个右转口。

The teacher at our first aid post might need help sticking plasters on. The quickest way to get to first aid is to head up the footpath next to school, and when you get to the second turning on the right, head down there, and it's sort of opposite the satellite dish.
休息区是距离“南停车场（south car park）”最近的地方，并且“靠近马路（near the road）”，对应字母G。
你可能会因为没听清而找错停车场，地图上标了南、北两个，一定要锁定位于左下方的“南停车场（south car park）”。
The rest area is for children needing a break, and that's the place nearest the south car park, near the road.
沿小路一直往上走，让“旗杆在你的左边（flag post on your left）”，“卫星天线在你的右边（satellite dish on your right）”，拍摄点就在“树的前面（in front of the trees）”，对应字母D。
你可能会因为左右两个参照物听反，或者忽略了最后“在树的前面”这个关键定位点而导致找错位置。

And if any parent here is handy with a video camera, we'd really appreciate some help with filming the event. This means heading up the footpath by the school, then keep going up. With the flag post on your left and the satellite dish on your right, and the filming spot is just there in front of the trees.
